groups.title: E0 · Foundation
groups.goal: Authoritative Rust entry, knowledge OS, domain meaning over opaque bytes.

items.label: Client enters a world on the lab
items.detail: The private client can reach a world through the Python measuring rig. That rig replays a capture. It is not the authoritative server.

items.label: Knowledge OS
items.detail: Short STATUS, ontology, nested AGENTS, no legacy public roadmap wall.

items.label: Domain lift (model vs wire)
items.detail: Gameplay speaks domain types; each ladder rung maps to an ontology concept.

groups.title: E1 · Presence & persist
groups.goal: Peers see each other; characters survive relog.

items.label: Presence codec layouts
items.detail: Live unmarshal for wires 449/574/391/407/422/106; raise ontology to layout.

items.label: Authoritative presence egress
items.detail: Server originates actor state; two bots see each other.

items.label: Character persistence
items.detail: Relog restores the same character aggregate.

groups.title: E2 · Playable loop
groups.goal: Gather, combat, quests, leveling, dungeons, crafting, PvP basics.

items.label: Gather + inventory + basic PvE
items.detail: Nodes, loot, bags; authoritative combat outcomes.

items.label: Quests + leveling
items.detail: Accept/turn-in and XP from shipped tables.

groups.title: E3 · Studio ops
groups.goal: Command bus, live map, privacy API, GM tools.

items.label: opsd + audited commands
items.detail: Kick/ban/grant with audit-before-apply; Grafana + map feed.

groups.title: E4 · Ship & scale
groups.goal: Compose/k8s, launcher, capacity gates, retire Python play path.

items.label: Docker compose clone path
items.detail: Same binaries as bare ef.py dev.

groups.title: E5 · Open & extend
groups.goal: Public GitHub, player landing, client sovereignty, content.

items.label: Open GitHub + CI + agent triage
items.detail: External PRs; required checks; no unattended high-risk merge.

items.label: Client sovereignty
items.detail: No AWS on the play path.
